name: Surfer Girl
description: Surfer Girl is an indie-reggae project led by Carter Reeves, blending surf-rock, pop, and laid-back beach vibes, featured on your playlist with 'Evil'.

name: The Elovaters
description: The Elovaters are a prominent reggae-rock band hailing from Boston, Massachusetts, known for chart-topping hits like 'Upside Down', 'Be Alright', and 'So Many Reasons'.

name: DannyLux
description: DannyLux is a prominent singer-songwriter in the modern Música Mexicana and sierreño movement, featured on your playlist with 'Mil Razones'.

name: Tropidelic
description: Tropidelic is a genre-bending band fusing reggae, hip-hop, and funk, featured on your playlist with 'Dollar Saved'.

name: Cuco
description: Cuco is a Mexican-American singer-songwriter celebrated for his dream-pop and alternative soundscapes, featured on your playlist with 'Sitting In The Corner'.

name: Red Hot Chili Peppers
description: Red Hot Chili Peppers are legendary Rock and Roll Hall of Fame alternative icons, featured on your playlist with 'White Braids & Pillow Chair'.

name: The Expendables
description: The Expendables are a Santa Cruz-based band blending surf-rock, reggae, and punk rock, featured on your playlist with 'Burning Up (Acoustic)'.

name: The Weeknd
description: The Weeknd is a Canadian singer, songwriter, and record producer known for his sonic versatility and dark lyricism in contemporary R&B and synth-pop.

name: Taylor Swift
description: Taylor Swift is an American singer-songwriter whose narrative songwriting, spanning multiple genres, has profoundly influenced the music industry and popular culture.

name: Bad Bunny
description: Bad Bunny is a Puerto Rican rapper and singer, often called the 'King of Latin Trap', known for redefining global urban music standards.

name: Billie Eilish
description: Billie Eilish is an American singer-songwriter celebrated for her distinctive whispered vocals, minimalist dark-pop production, and alternative style.

name: Kendrick Lamar
description: Kendrick Lamar is an American rapper and songwriter widely regarded as one of the most influential hip-hop artists of his generation.

name: Bruno Mars
description: Bruno Mars is an American singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist celebrated for his retro showmanship, funk, soul, and R&B hits.
